approval_source: Perfecto, continuamos con la autorización explícita del brief.
subject: M1A_EXECUTABLE_SCHEMA_TEMPLATE_AND_OVERLAY_MATERIALIZATION
objective: Materialize the executable artifacts required by PEND-LAB-033, generate four isolated CRITERION_MODULE package instances and rerun M1 using mechanically reproducible validation, without modifying the active selector, creating M2 artifacts or producing runtime effects.
required_first_actions: Verify the live remote HEAD of main.
Stop without writing if the HEAD is not the expected_parent_head.
Read project-sources/chatgpt/START_HERE.md and follow its complete order.
Materialize the exact approved brief at brief_canonical_path without reducing its scope, validation requirements, prohibitions or stop conditions.
Materialize this authorization record at authorization_canonical_path before publishing the execution result.
allowed_actions: Read all canonical sources and M0/M1 evidence referenced by the approved brief.
Declare one executable JSON Schema dialect compatible with repository conventions.
Use JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 only if no conflicting repository convention exists.
Create the ten executable common schema files declared by INTEGRATION_PACKAGE_SCHEMA_SET_001.
Create the thirteen executable common template files declared by INTEGRATION_TEMPLATE_CATALOG_001.
Create the three CRITERION_MODULE overlay files declared by INTEGRATION_TEMPLATE_CATALOG_001.
Create required authorization templates exclusively as draft generators incapable of granting authority automatically.
Generate four isolated candidate packages for EVIDENCE_AND_CLAIMS, DESIGN_CRITERION, WEB_ACCESSIBILITY and CONTEXTUAL_VISUAL_PREFERENCE.
Use structured UNRESOLVED markers for values not established by canonical sources.
Create or minimally extend a deterministic local validation harness.
Add a pinned validation-only development dependency only when existing repository tooling is insufficient.
Validate schemas, templates, overlays, generated packages, references, invariants, unresolved markers and authority boundaries.
Verify preservation of the complete M0 baseline.
Rerun M1 and classify it as PASS or BLOCKED strictly from mechanical evidence.
Update SCHEMA_VALIDATION_REPORT.json and TEMPLATE_INSTANTIATION_REPORT.json.
Create M1A execution evidence and required registry deltas.
Close PEND-LAB-033 only if every required resolution and M1 exit gate passes.
Commit the bounded changes to main.
Push the commit to the remote main branch.
Verify the resulting remote HEAD and report it.
authority_safety_requirements: authority_effect must be explicit in every governed artifact.
runtime_effect must be explicit in every governed artifact.
implementation_authorized must default to false where applicable.
No template, generator, validator or instance may infer GRANTED authorization.
All generated authorization artifacts must begin in DRAFT or PROPOSED.
approved_by must remain unresolved until supplied through a separate valid human authorization.
Generation, validation, commit, push, audit or technical success must not alter authorization state automatically.
baseline_preservation_requirements: Preserve all four current criterion modules.
Preserve the 13 frozen M0 fixture blob references.
Do not modify the active MODULE_SELECTOR.json.
Do not modify current ChatGPT behavior.
validation_requirements: Validation must run locally without cloud services or production credentials.
Provide one deterministic documented validation command or command sequence.
Pin any newly introduced validation dependency.
Every executable schema must declare its dialect.
Every executable schema must pass meta-schema validation.
All templates and overlays must resolve without missing references.
All four generated package instances must validate against applicable schemas.
Every unavailable value must use the approved structured UNRESOLVED representation.
No generated authorization may have status GRANTED.
No provider-specific value may define the portable core.
No global stack or production provider may be selected.
Rollback must be explicit before any package can be test-ready.
A second validation run over unchanged inputs must produce equivalent normalized results.
All validation failures and divergences must be retained in machine-readable evidence.
stop_conditions: The live remote HEAD differs from expected_parent_head.
A canonical contradiction affects the authorized implementation.
Materialization requires changing active selector behavior.
Validation requires AWS, Terraform, provisioning or production credentials.
The work requires creating M2 or shadow-registry artifacts.
A generated artifact could grant authorization automatically.
A required unresolved value cannot be represented safely and explicitly.
A necessary change falls outside the LAB repository.
Any requested operation exceeds this authorization.
required_outputs: The canonically stored approved M1A brief.
Draft-only authorization-generation templates required by the brief.
A deterministic validation harness and execution instructions.
Updated PEND-LAB-033 only when justified by evidence.
Verified commit SHA and remote HEAD.

commit_contract.suggested_commit_message: feat(lab): materialize integration factory M1A executable artifacts

consumption_criterion: CONSUMED after the authorized M1A attempt, all required evidence and bounded documentary records are committed and pushed to main, the resulting remote HEAD is verified, and M1 is accurately classified as PASS or BLOCKED. A technically blocked result consumes this authorization once the complete authorized attempt and evidence publication are finished.
